description: Public anonymization / PII gold tests that make up this package's gold-corpus. Downloadable sources are fetched by scripts/download_gold_corpus.py into data/gold-corpus/ (gitignored). Sources marked downloadable=false are documented only.

sources.name: Text Anonymization Benchmark (TAB)
sources.notes: Official GoldCorpus in evaluation.py. 1,268 English ECHR court cases with DIRECT/QUASI/NO_MASK identifier types. This is the dedicated public text-anonymization test.

sources.name: Presidio research synth_dataset_v2
sources.notes: Public synthetic eval set shipped with Microsoft Presidio research. The de-facto open test for Presidio-class PII recognizers.

sources.name: Gretel PII Masking EN v1 (test split)
sources.notes: 5,000 synthetic documents across ~47 industry domains (healthcare, banking, identity, government-adjacent, etc.) with span-locatable PII/PHI labels.

sources.name: In-repo use-case pack
sources.notes: Tiny committed fixture covering healthcare, legal, government, research, finance, and enterprise/AI. Always available without a download.

sources.name: In-repo mini TAB fixture
sources.notes: Existing package public test from item 13 (PR #52).

sources.name: i2b2 / n2c2 clinical de-identification challenges
sources.notes: The classic clinical de-id gold (2006, 2014, 2016). Requires a credentialed PhysioNet account and a data-use agreement. Not auto-downloaded.

sources.name: MIMIC de-identified notes
sources.notes: Already de-identified EHR notes. Not a detection gold set, and not downloadable without a DUA.

sources.name: The Learning Agency Lab — PII Data Detection
sources.notes: Student-essay PII gold. Requires a Kaggle login. Not auto-downloaded.

sources.name: MAPA — Multilingual Anonymisation for Public Administrations
sources.notes: EU public-administration anonymization set on ELRC-SHARE. Registration required. Not auto-downloaded.
